root_cause_criterion.description: The stack buffer tok1 is declared without initialization before the first token read, leaving tail bytes outside n1 + 1 uninitialized and reachable by the later /WMode strcmp.

nodes.description: At the /WMode keyword-dispatch site, strcmp needs a 7-byte /WMode\0 read while only n1 + 1 bytes of tok1 are known initialized from the first tokenization result

edges.description: The uninitialized gap exists immediately after the first getToken call because tok1 capacity stays 256 bytes while only n1 + 1 bytes are initialized
The same initialization boundary n1 + 1 propagates unchanged from the first tok1 materialization to the /WMode compare chain
